title: One suite of T-495's claimable half: answer-length-depth rewritten from a source-text scanner into a behavioural suite, and wired
scope: One suite, because T-495's acceptance is per suite. It is suite 5 of the 11 in the claimable half; 6 remain, all in src/__tests__/integration/agents.
The gated half of T-495 -- the rows carrying textIsTheSubject -- is NOT touched here.

This record exists so the T-770 control resolves this path's classification from the LATEST record rather than from the T-492 draw, which is left as the historical draw it is. Measured: with the workflow step added and this record absent, t770-scanner-wiring-refusal fails 2 of 7 and names this suite.
method: Re-verified on origin/main 5fbde65541 by running the suite, not by reading it: 5 passed of 5. Three of the five read synthesizer.ts as text -- one sliced the file from the literal 'ANSWER-ONLY STREAMING MODE' to its end, one grepped it for '200-word target', one grepped it for every 'Target 90-160 words' run up to the next double quote. Green was never the criterion.

The three scanner cases were DELETED rather than repaired. The two cases over the exported contract constants CXO_ANSWER_QUALITY_CONTRACT and GENERAL_ADVISORY_CONTRACT were already behaviour -- they assert the value of an exported string -- and are kept byte-for-byte, as the T-492 verdict for this file asked.

Replacement cases drive the real synthesizeStream down both of its paths (answerOnlyStreaming true, the live chat path; and false, the rich-text non-streaming path) and read the exact system and user content through the synthesizer's own onModelInput hook. Only the audited Anthropic client is mocked, because it is I/O; every prompt builder and the model-input cleaner run for real.

Non-vacuity measured by a throwaway probe, not assumed: each path's system input carries exactly 3 'Target 90-160 words' lines (the CXO contract, the universal answer contract and the rich-text override), and the streaming path carries exactly one ANSWER-ONLY STREAMING MODE line.

The first draft matched every line mentioning '90-160 words' and failed 2 of 7: the shape contract's PYRAMID BRIEF OVERRIDE names 90-160 words as the 'preferred default for an analytical answer' with no 400-word clause. That line states a default, not a cap, and was outside the deleted case's own rule, so the matcher was narrowed to 'Target 90-160 words' -- the statement the deleted case matched -- with the reason written in the suite. The line is recorded under residuals rather than silently excluded.
Five mutations against synthesizer.ts, each verified by git diff --numstat to have changed the file before either suite ran, and each run against the new suite and the deleted scanner.

suites.rationale: The three deleted cases asserted that words appear in synthesizer.ts. Measured against two mutations that change what a model receives -- the answer-only directive dropped from the system prompt template, and a computed '200-word target' appended to the user prompt -- the deleted scanner stayed green on both. Five behavioural cases replace them: the streaming path's system input carries one ANSWER-ONLY STREAMING MODE line with the 'Length follows depth', roughly-400-word and portfolio-review allowance; on each path every 'Target 90-160 words' line the model reads also states the 400-word allowance; and on each path neither system nor user input references a '200-word target'.

mutations.mutation: drop ${answerOnlyDirective} from both rawSystem templates, so the streaming directive is never sent
mutations.catches: the streaming directive reaching the model

mutations.mutation: strip ', up to roughly 400 words where the question needs it' from the universal answer contract line
mutations.catches: a target line without the deep-dive allowance, on both paths

mutations.mutation: in the answer-only directive, 'may run to roughly 400 words' -> 'may run to roughly 160 words'
append a computed ['200', 'word target'].join('-') sentence to the user prompt
mutations.catches: a stale length target reaching the model, on both paths

mutations.mutation: append a computed 'Target 90-160 words for every answer, whatever its depth.' line to the system input
mutations.catches: a new target line that caps deep dives, on both paths

residualsNotClosedHere: The directory src/lib/intelligence/ask/__tests__ still cannot be wired whole: it holds ask-guardrails.test.ts, left red on purpose behind an owner decision (T-497's gated half). The suite is named individually for that reason.

OBSERVED, not acted on -- a prompt-content decision, not a test decision: the PYRAMID BRIEF OVERRIDE paragraph in CONSULTANT_ANSWER_SHAPE_CONTRACT and CONSULTANT_ANSWER_SHAPE_CONTRACT_RICH (response-policy.ts) reaches the model on both paths and says an analytical answer is 'Answer -> Proof -> Move in 90-160 words' and that 'Answer', 'Proof' and 'Move' are the allowed labels, while the universal answer contract (sent on both paths) and the ANSWER-ONLY STREAMING MODE directive (streaming path) say never to print 'Answer', 'Proof' or 'Move' as a header or lead-in. Filed to the backlog as decision needed.
